concerns.text: Task T016a iterates over seeds [42, 43, 44, 45, 46] (5 seeds), violating Spec SC-004 and Task T025b which explicitly require calculating robustness (CV of ECE) across exactly 3 seeds [42, 43, 44]. This introduces unnecessary computational load and misaligns the seed set with the success criterion definition.

Task T015 (Sparse GP Fitting) fails to implement the deliverable required by Spec FR-005: 'report the reconstruction variance as a separate metric'. The task only saves the model and lacks any implementation step to calculate or output this specific metric, resulting in a semantic weakening of the functional requirement.

Task T022 sets aleatoric and epistemic variance to 'null' for Sparse GP, violating Spec FR-008 which mandates reporting 'total variance as a proxy' for Sparse GP. The task logic discards the total variance output rather than explicitly labeling and reporting it as the required proxy.

Task T028a defaults the recall target to 0.8 if the config value is missing, bypassing the requirement in Spec US-3 (Acceptance Scenario 2) and SC-003 to use a specific value determined during research (marked [deferred]). This silent fallback to a hardcoded value weakens the requirement to validate or report the actual target used.

Task T029b conflates the acceptance criteria in Spec US-3 (Acceptance Scenario 2) by making the 5% precision gain a fallback only if McNemar's test is inconclusive. The spec requires the condition to be met if 'p-value < 0.05 OR precision gain >= 5%'. The task logic incorrectly structures this as a sequential failure path rather than a parallel acceptance criterion.
